description: Turns mouse-wheel movement and middle-mouse clicks into 10V triggers and gates.

params.text: Limits capture of mouse-wheel and middle-click events to the times a parameter is hovered; switched off, they are caught wherever the mouse points.

outputs.text: Fires a 10V trigger on every step of the mouse wheel downwards.
Fires a 10V trigger on every step of the mouse wheel upwards.
Goes to 10V on a middle-mouse click, as a trigger, as a gate while the button is held, or as a level toggled by each click, set on the menu.

notes: only the first instance with a given set of modifiers receives events, so further instances need different modifiers.
menu: Modifier — requires Shift, Ctrl or Alt to be held before a mouse-wheel event is caught, which leaves plain scrolling free to move the Rack view.
Middle click mode — Off, Toggle, Trigger or Gate, setting what the middle-click output carries.
